annotations.title: Make or change an App Store in-app event

description: Makes a new In-App Event (no eventId: referenceName and badge required) or changes a draft or rejected one (eventId; send only what changes). Nothing reaches people until App Review approves it (ploa_event_submit). Fields: referenceName (≤64, only in App Store Connect), badge (LIVE_EVENT, PREMIERE, CHALLENGE, COMPETITION, NEW_SEASON, MAJOR_UPDATE, SPECIAL_EVENT), deepLink (universal link or the app's URL; null removes), purchaseRequirement (NO_COST_ASSOCIATED, IN_APP_PURCHASE), priority (NORMAL, HIGH), purpose (APPROPRIATE_FOR_ALL_USERS, ATTRACT_NEW_USERS, KEEP_ACTIVE_USERS_INFORMED, BRING_BACK_LAPSED_USERS), primaryLocale, schedules: [{ territories: "all" or ["USA", ...] (Apple's 3-letter codes), publishStart, eventStart, eventEnd }] as ISO dates (at most 31 days long, shown at most 14 days before the start), locales: { "en-US": { name (≤30), shortDescription (≤50), longDescription (≤120) }, "fr-FR": null removes a language }. No prices or "#1" claims in the text (App Review rejects them). Then add media with ploa_event_media_upload. Needs a token allowed to submit.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

eventId.description: The event to change; leave out to make a new one.
